systems.owner: Government of Senegal; the ministry of communication, telecommunications and digital reports it
systems.tiers: Citizens and businesses: requests for the criminal record extract (casier judiciaire) and nationality certificate, and administrative appointments; in service by March 2026
The public, by telephone: taxes, fines and administrative fees in one system
Foreign nationals apply, pay and receive a visa online
Senegalese abroad: passport, consular card and civil status requests with online payment

note: A ministry account of one year of the New Deal Technologique, relayed by APS. It names public-facing portals and an interoperability platform (e-Jokko) whose first uses are tax, customs and social protection; it says nothing of police or gendarmerie stations or how they record a complaint or a case.
